e_u_conditional.trigger: Shieldify M-01 (acknowledged): any address can call voter.poke(tokenId) after the epoch vote window; for a veNFT decayed to balanceOfNFT==0 it takes the _reset branch and zeroes the victim's current-epoch FeeVotingReward/BribeVotingReward checkpoints, redistributing that epoch's fees/bribes pro-rata to the OTHER depositors of those Reward contracts. The caller receives nothing directly; monetisation needs the attacker to already hold a veUP stake in the same Reward (gain = attacker share x victim forfeited share). Fork-proven live: poke(16) by a fresh address succeeds on a zero-weight veNFT. Second conditional: M-03 cap-mode bypass (permissionless updateFor while a governance cap-mode switch is queued) - not live today (pendingCapMode==capMode==2 Enforced, epoch 0).
